_about: The general review's MEASURED score per paper kind (order 14, piece G). Read only by app/aim_review_measured.py and shown on the results page and in the Excel file. found_mean = planted mistakes found out of 'out_of' (10): found by code minus chance hits on the original, averaged over the planted copies. A row with found_mean null is a PLACEHOLDER: the page says 'has not been measured yet'. The lead fills in real numbers from the score files; never type a number here that no score file shows. Keys are the app's kind words (document_kinds.json); a datasheet may also have a row per equipment type under 'equipment_types'.
